headline.title: 加密货币巨头币安遭黑客攻击，疑似史上最大规模
headline.summary: 币安称约63亿美元资金受影响，两家分析机构将此次攻击归咎于朝鲜黑客组织TraderTraitor；这被认为是加密货币行业最大规模黑客事件。
headline.title_en: Crypto giant Binance hit by hack suspected to be largest in history
headline.summary_en: Binance said about $6.3bn in funds were affected, and two analytics firms attributed the breach to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor, in what is described as crypto’s largest-ever hack.
